verdict.rationale: Hightouch ships AI features (a built-in agent, AI Decisioning, ad creative generation, and an MCP server), so a buyer can fairly ask whether customer data is used for model training. The evidence pack has no AI-training opt-out, no data-usage policy, and no statement that customer data is excluded from training. The community note that data stays in the customer's warehouse speaks to storage architecture, not AI training use, so it does not establish this capability.
